node.title: Exact Johnson bound closes the above-threshold K4 auxiliary charts
node.statement: For an auxiliary RS list of degree-<=d polynomials on T, |T|=ell, with agreement N and N^2>d ell, the complete list has size at most floor(ell(N-d)/(N^2-d ell))<=ell^2. Hence every G1 chart in this range satisfies K4 with b4=2 before imposing the stabilizer-primitive filter; only N^2<=d|T| remains open.
